CustomField.formula:
IF( TEXT(LicenseType__r.AuditType__c) = "Pre-Audit", IF( OR ( AND( LicenseType__r.DurationofLicenseInMonths__c = 24, OriginalDateofLicensure__c >= LicenseType__r.LicenseTypeEffectiveDate__c , ISPICKVAL( LicenseType__r.ExcludeLicensesbyDateofLicensure__c , "Licensed within Current Biennium (First Renewal)") ),
AND( LicenseType__r.DurationofLicenseInMonths__c = 36, OriginalDateofLicensure__c >= LicenseType__r.LicenseTypeEffectiveDate__c , ISPICKVAL( LicenseType__r.ExcludeLicensesbyDateofLicensure__c , "Licensed within Current Triennium (First Renewal)") ),
AND( LicenseType__r.DurationofLicenseInMonths__c = 24, OriginalDateofLicensure__c >= LicenseType__r.SecondYearStart__c , ISPICKVAL( LicenseType__r.ExcludeLicensesbyDateofLicensure__c , "Licensed in the 2nd half of Current Biennium (2NB)") ),
AND( OriginalDateofLicensure__c >= LicenseType__r.NextLicensePeriodEffectiveDate__c , ISPICKVAL( LicenseType__r.ExcludeLicensesbyDateofLicensure__c , "Licensed in the new License Period (New)") ) ), true, false),
IF( OR ( AND( LicenseType__r.DurationofLicenseInMonths__c = 24, OriginalDateofLicensure__c >= LicenseType__r.PreviousLicensePeriodEffectiveDate__c , ISPICKVAL( LicenseType__r.ExcludeLicensesbyDateofLicensure__c , "Licensed within Current Biennium (First Renewal)") ),
AND( LicenseType__r.DurationofLicenseInMonths__c = 36, OriginalDateofLicensure__c >= LicenseType__r.PreviousLicensePeriodEffectiveDate__c , ISPICKVAL( LicenseType__r.ExcludeLicensesbyDateofLicensure__c , "Licensed within Current Triennium (First Renewal)") ),
AND( LicenseType__r.DurationofLicenseInMonths__c = 24, OriginalDateofLicensure__c >= LicenseType__r.PreviousSecondYearStart__c , ISPICKVAL( LicenseType__r.ExcludeLicensesbyDateofLicensure__c , "Licensed in the 2nd half of Current Biennium (2NB)") ),
AND( OriginalDateofLicensure__c >= LicenseType__r.LicenseTypeEffectiveDate__c , ISPICKVAL( LicenseType__r.ExcludeLicensesbyDateofLicensure__c , "Licensed in the new License Period (New)") ) ), true, false)
)
CustomField.label: Exclude Audit
